# 2 Baruch Chapter 51 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Fourth Fast and Dialogue
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 51:3 — transformation of the righteous

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "their-splendour will-then-be-glorified in-changes, and-the-form-of-their-face will-be-turned into-the-light-of-their-beauty" |
| LOGOS | "their splendor will then be glorified in changes, and the form of their face will be turned into the light of their beauty" |
| PNEUMA | "Their faces will be illuminated with the light of their own beauty" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac phrase involves a double transformation (glorification plus facial light); PNEUMA's compression loses the two-stage nature of the transformation.

---

## 51:5 — contrast of fates

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-shall-be-transformed, the-latter into-the-splendour-of-angels, and-the-former shall-waste-away still-more" |
| LOGOS | "they shall be transformed — the latter into the splendor of angels, and the former shall waste away still more" |
| PNEUMA | "the righteous will shine like angels, while the wicked will be further consumed" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac uses 'the latter/former' (demonstratives) to mark the two groups precisely; PNEUMA's substitution of 'righteous/wicked' is interpretive.

---

## 51:14 — angelic equality formula

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "they-will-be-made-like-unto-the-angels, and-be-made-equal-to-the-stars" |
| LOGOS | "they will be made like unto the angels, and be made equal to the stars" |
| PNEUMA | "made like the angels, equal to the stars" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The archaic 'like unto' preserves the Syriac da'ykh ('as/like') plus an intensifying preposition better than PNEUMA's abbreviated form.

---
